The lady doctor (I forgot to ask her name) was very professional and friendly. She took time to explain my issue (Ear Barotrauma) in detail. I was positively surprised as I didn’t expect such a good professional service and consultation. This was much better than most of the health consultations I have received (compared to professional health care services in a western country).

All the staff speaks very good English so communications with staff/doctors is not a problem at all. The place is very clean and the chairs/bed in the consultation rooms are sanitized after every patient. To keep the interior clean and hygienic, you need to remove the street shoes when you enter the clinic (indoor slippers are provided).

This place is highly recommended in case you need medical consultation/treatments during your stay in Chiang Mai.

Prior to arriving in Chiang Mai, CM Mediclinic corresponded with me professionally, quickly, and in clear and perfect English.
